name: VerifierLab
heading: Reward the task. Not the shortcut.
description: Compare weak and strict verifiers on synthetic form-completion trajectories. Inspect reward hacking and false-positive rewards without claiming a trained model improved.
label: Trajectories (JSON)
sample: Complete the synthetic form with email demo@example.test, explicit consent, and a submitted confirmation. The strict verifier requires all three; the weak verifier checks only submission.
notice: Deterministic environment/verifier case study. No training or model improvement. All email addresses use the reserved example.test domain.
